resources.string: Wide backgrounds for Spotify artist pages from fanart.tv. Free key at fanart.tv/get-an-api-key. Without it, the server library or the blurred cover is used.
Open this address on a phone or PC on the same network (or scan the code) to download the log. It stays available for 10 minutes or until you close this.
The log can be downloaded on the home network.
No Wi-Fi/Ethernet network: the log cannot be shared.
